name: Aegis AI Escrow & Verification Proxy
description: Conditional execution and quality-check escrow proxy for x402 agent micro-payments.
author: Aegis AI Team

capabilities.name: inspect_and_pay
capabilities.description: Forward a request to a vendor and inspect its response. Payment settlement requires a configured x402 facilitator; demo mode only simulates payment acceptance.

parameters.target_url: string (required) - Same-origin mock path, or HTTPS endpoint on VENDOR_ALLOWLIST
parameters.expected_key: string (optional) - JSON key expected in the response to pass inspection
parameters.payload: object (optional) - Body data to send to seller
